title: MissingReferenceException: The object of type 'CosmicShore.Gameplay.Player' has been destroyed but you are still trying
notes: Fix 2026-10-15 by claude: Root cause: GameDataSO.LocalPlayer kept pointing at a destroyed Player (Player.OnNetworkDespawn left the roster but never cleared the handle), and IPlayer?. never reaches Unity's destroyed-object test, so ObjectiveIndicator.LateUpdate -> GateRaceController.TryGetNextGate read RoundStats off a corpse every frame. Fix (ported from claude/lucid-cray-mcc324): LocalPlayer / LocalRoundStats / Player.Vessel self-heal to null through UnityLiveness; Player getters answer null once destroyed; Player.OnDestroy (an override, so Netcode's own teardown still runs) leaves the roster.
